<thought>We will search the template catalog using functional group criteria. The target molecule SMILES is corrected to a valid form: "C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CCCC1(O)C(F)(F)F". This represents the product of a carbonyl‑ene reaction (ketone and alkene broken, forming an aliphatic hydroxyl). We'll search for templates that break ketones and C‑C double bonds and form aliphatic hydroxyls.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CCCC1(O)C(F)(F)F",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
